description: Prior Approval for Agricultural building : Barn for Hay, Machinery Storage and Operation and Storage
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">The applicant has failed to demonstrate that
the land is “agricultural land” as defined by Schedule 2, Part 6 D.1 of The
Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015
as amended. There is insufficient evidence to show that the land is in use as
agricultural land and is so used for the purposes of a trade or business.
Furthermore, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposal is
“reasonably necessary” for the purpose of agriculture within the unit as
defined by Schedule 2, Part 6 Class A of The Town and Country Planning (General
Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.&nbsp;&nbsp;<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposal fails to comply with Schedule 2,
Part 6, Class A.1 (e) (ii) of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted
Development) Order 2015 (as amended) as the proposed works would exceed a
ground area of 1500sq.m within the agricultural unit.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="line-height: 107%;">The proposal would be accessed by an access
track and bridge that is subject to an enforcement notice for their removal and
are unlawful. Therefore, such works would go beyond that which would be
permitted by way of Class A, Part 6, Schedule 2 of The Town and Country
Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 as amended.<font face="Arial, sans-serif"><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><o:p></o:p></span></font></span></p>
